name: Srinagar — IED on route, then stone pelting on the alternative
description: Safest-route convoy from the city centre to west Srinagar at 10x. At 60 s an IED (road closed) is reported 700 m ahead, forcing a mandatory reroute. At 150 s stone pelting is reported 600 m ahead on the new (alternative) route. SYNTHETIC - for demonstration only.

steps.text: Convoy departed from the start point (SP).

steps.description: Scenario: suspicious object reported on the convoy's route. (Fictional.)
Scenario: crowd gathering and stone throwing on the alternative route. (Fictional.)
